title: Gromov width of symmetric polar products
exact_target: For every $n\geq2$ and origin-symmetric convex body $K\subset\mathbb{R}^n$, with $K^\circ=\{y:\langle x,y\rangle\leq1\text{ for all }x\in K\}$, does $\operatorname{int}(K\times K^\circ)\subset\mathbb{R}^{2n}$ with the standard symplectic structure have Gromov width $4$; equivalently, does every open standard ball of capacity $c<4$ admit a smooth symplectic embedding into it, and none of capacity $c>4$?
